recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit FHIR-12690 only if Patient Care reintroduces an inline CarePlan activity definition element; in that case ActivityDefinition should remain an allowed target.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive technical correction to add ActivityDefinition as an allowed reference target for CarePlan.activity.detail.definition alongside PlanDefinition.
initial_application: Commit 080534600a039a1721ecf27cd415885eeb011f80 explicitly applied #12690 by changing CarePlan.activity.detail.definition from Reference(PlanDefinition|Questionnaire) to Reference(PlanDefinition|ActivityDefinition|Questionnaire).
additional_context: FHIR-26064 renamed CarePlan.activity.detail to plannedActivityDetail, and FHIR-39101 later removed plannedActivityDetail and its children. The combined branch already has reconciliation commits for both related issues. Current combined source has CarePlan active but plannedActivityDetail is commented out and therefore not current build behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the historical target was added, then the active element was superseded/removed by later final Patient Care decisions.

related_jiras.note: Renamed CarePlan.activity.detail to CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail before that successor element was later removed; already represented on the combined branch.

Removed CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and its children, superseding the need for an active current target on the old inline-detail definition element; already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive Patient Care technical correction requesting ActivityDefinition as an allowed CarePlan.activity.detail.definition target alongside PlanDefinition.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the narrow final request and the old CarePlan element path to reconcile.

evidence_items.summary: The 2017 thread records agreement that CarePlan.activity.detail.definition should be able to point to either PlanDefinition or ActivityDefinition and that the change was a simple correction.
evidence_items.learned: The community context aligns with the Jira request and supports the original application.

evidence_items.summary: The explicit #12690 implementation changed CarePlan.activity.detail.definition from Reference(PlanDefinition|Questionnaire) to Reference(PlanDefinition|ActivityDefinition|Questionnaire).

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring removal of CarePlan.activity.plannedActivityDetail and its children.

evidence_items.learned: The checked source is in build scope, but the old FHIR-12690 element path is legacy rather than an active element to edit.
